chunks: From him, from Ali ibn Hassan, from the one who mentioned it, from Dawud ibn Farqad, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
Three are the signs of the Believer: his knowledge of Allah, and whom he loves, and whom he hates.
ai.seo_question: What are the three signs of a true believer according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: This hadith from Al-Kafi identifies knowledge of Allah, love (Tawalli), and hatred (Tawalli) as the three fundamental markers of a true believer, emphasizing that faith is not merely internal but expressed through correct allegiance and enmity. In Shia scholarship, this triad underscores that true Iman requires both intellectual conviction and emotional alignment with divine will, extending beyond personal piety to social and cosmic loyalty.

en.hubeali:
From him, from Ali Bin Hassan, from the one who mentioned it, from Dawood Bin Farqad, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘There (things) are from the signs of a Momin (the Believer) – His knowledge in Allahazwj, and the one whom he loves, and the one whom he hates’.
en.sarwar: 9. It is narrated from him (narrator of the Hadith above) from Ali ibn Hassan from those he has mentioned (in his book) from Dawud ibn Farqad from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following:
“Abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) has said, ‘Three things are of the signs of a believer: His knowledge of Allah, who to love and who to hate.’”
